name: Rush
author: Erin Carter
description: A rank of cattail rushes stands along a moonlit waterline, mirrored in still black water below. A gust front crosses the bed stem by stem — each rush bows and overshoots, glow gathering on its downwind edge and rimming its head — then springs back into a long stillness, the reflection echoing every gesture a beat late.

params.label: Gust rate
params.effect: How often gust fronts cross the reed bed.

params.label: Bend
params.effect: How far the rushes bow and overshoot when a front passes.

params.label: Reed spacing
params.effect: CSS-pixel spacing between rushes along the waterline.

params.label: Reflection
params.effect: Brightness of the mirrored rank in the water, from absent to nearly as vivid as the reeds.
